title: Monopetalous
summary: MONOPET'ALOUS, adjective [Gr. only, and flower-leaf.] In botany, having only one petal, or a one-petaled corol; as a monopetalous corol or flower.

inlines.v: MONOPET'ALOUS, adjective [Gr. only, and flower-leaf.] In botany, having only one petal, or a one-petaled corol; as a monopetalous corol or flower.
